title: Camellia sinensis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Camellia sinensis essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the leaves of the Camellia sinensis plant, which is the same plant used to produce green, black, and white tea. This essential oil is obtained through steam distillation and contains a complex blend of phytochemicals, including catechins, caffeine, and various volatile compounds. In herbalism, it is used for its potential calming and stimulating effects, often applied in aromatherapy to reduce stress and enhance mental clarity. It may also be used topically to support skin health and as a natural remedy for mild digestive discomfort. However, due to its potency, it is typically diluted before use and should be handled with care.
